sections.title: Consumer mediation
sections.content:
In accordance with Articles L.612-1 et seq. of the French Consumer Code (Code de la consommation), any consumer residing in France has the right to have recourse, free of charge, to a consumer mediator with a view to the amicable resolution of a dispute with a professional.
